title: RigorLoop Scenario
description: RigorLoop profile for a governed stakeholder-observable Scenario. Schema validation checks content shape, lifecycle vocabulary, and primary-Feature cardinality; ownership, relationship resolution, lifecycle transitions, and engineering adequacy require separate checks.

title.description: Readable name identifying the stakeholder goal and distinguishing situation. The repository derives the filename suffix from the full title; clarity and filename agreement require checks beyond this schema.

status.description: Lifecycle state of Scenario analysis, not implementation or requirement satisfaction. A schema check does not authorize a transition.

goal.description: The single stakeholder-visible outcome pursued by the actor.

interaction.description: Stakeholder actions and observable system responses in order; no internal design or Function call sequence.

alternatives.description: Different observable paths that still achieve the stated Scenario goal.

failures.description: Conditions preventing or limiting the Scenario goal, with the observable outcome or required handling. Correct handling does not make the desired goal achieved.

exercises.description: The one primary Feature. May be empty during drafting; confirmed and obsolete records retain exactly one primary Feature.

informs.description: SRs informed by this Scenario. May be empty while system obligations are still being derived.

coverage_note.description: Optional explicit SR-analysis conclusion explaining why no additional obligation is needed. It is analysis, not verification evidence.

open_questions.description: Optional single consequential unresolved question requiring a decision or evidence. Omit this field when none remains. Ask one question at a time; do not bundle independent questions. Engineering review assesses relevance and completeness.
